17	package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation;
18	
19	import java.time.LocalDate;
20	
21	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
22	
23	/**
24	 * Enforces that no more than {@value #MAX_OWNERS_PER_DAY} owners may be registered on a single day.
25	 * The owners already registered today are counted by their registration date via
26	 * {@link DailyRegistrationCounter}; once that count reaches the cap, no further owner may be created
27	 * until the next day.
28	 */
29	@Component
30	public class DailyRegistrationCapacityValidator {
31	
32	    /** The maximum number of owners that may be registered in a single day. */
33	    public static final long MAX_OWNERS_PER_DAY = 100;
34	
35	    private final DailyRegistrationCounter dailyRegistrationCounter;
36	
37	    public DailyRegistrationCapacityValidator(DailyRegistrationCounter dailyRegistrationCounter) {
38	        this.dailyRegistrationCounter = dailyRegistrationCounter;
39	    }
40	
41	    /**
42	     * Rejects an owner registration once {@value #MAX_OWNERS_PER_DAY} or more owners have already
43	     * been registered on the given day.
44	     *
45	     * @param day the (business) day the owner is being registered on
46	     * @throws DailyRegistrationLimitExceededException if that day is already at capacity
47	     */
48	    public void validateHasCapacity(LocalDate day) {
49	        if (this.dailyRegistrationCounter.count(day) >= MAX_OWNERS_PER_DAY) {
50	            throw new DailyRegistrationLimitExceededException(MAX_OWNERS_PER_DAY);
51	        }
52	    }
53	}

17	package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation;
18	
19	import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.service.ClinicService;
20	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
21	
22	/**
23	 * Counts how many existing owners share a given owner's name, i.e. have the same first name and
24	 * last name compared case-insensitively. The comparison is done in memory because the stored names
25	 * are not kept in a normalized form, done in memory for the same reason as the household matching
26	 * in {@link OwnerHouseholdRegistrar}.
27	 */
28	@Component
29	public class NamesakeCounter {
30	
31	    private final ClinicService clinicService;
32	
33	    public NamesakeCounter(ClinicService clinicService) {
34	        this.clinicService = clinicService;
35	    }
36	
37	    /**
38	     * Counts the existing owners whose first and last name match the given ones, case-insensitively.
39	     *
40	     * @param firstName the first name of the owner being created
41	     * @param lastName  the last name of the owner being created
42	     * @return the number of existing owners sharing that first and last name
43	     */
44	    public int count(String firstName, String lastName) {
45	        return (int) this.clinicService.findAllOwners().stream()
46	            .filter(existing -> equalsIgnoreCase(existing.getFirstName(), firstName)
47	                && equalsIgnoreCase(existing.getLastName(), lastName))
48	            .count();
49	    }
50	
51	    private static boolean equalsIgnoreCase(String a, String b) {
52	        return a != null && a.equalsIgnoreCase(b);
53	    }
54	}

32	
33	    public CityOwnerCounter(ClinicService clinicService) {
34	        this.clinicService = clinicService;
35	    }
36	
37	    /**
38	     * Counts the existing owners whose city matches the given one, case-insensitively.
39	     *
40	     * @param city the city of the owner being created
41	     * @return the number of existing owners in that city
42	     */
43	    public long count(String city) {
44	        return this.clinicService.findAllOwners().stream()
45	            .filter(existing -> existing.getCity() != null && existing.getCity().equalsIgnoreCase(city))
46	            .count();
47	    }
48	}

21	/**
22	 * Derives an owner's membership number, formatted {@code <customerCode>-M<YY>} where YY is
23	 * the last two digits, zero-padded, of the registration date year
24	 * (e.g. {@code SMI-0007-M26}).

26	public final class MembershipNumberGenerator {
27	
28	    private MembershipNumberGenerator() {
29	    }

31	    /**
32	     * Builds the membership number for a new owner.
33	     *
34	     * @param customerCode     the owner's customer code
35	     * @param registrationDate the owner's registration date
36	     * @return the membership number, e.g. {@code "SMI-0007-M26"}
37	     */
38	    public static String generate(String customerCode, LocalDate registrationDate) {
39	        return String.format("%s-M%02d", customerCode, registrationDate.getYear() % 100);
40	    }
41	}

19	import org.slf4j.Logger;
20	import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
21	import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner;
22	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
23	
24	/**
25	 * Writes owner-lifecycle audit records to the dedicated {@code AUDIT} logger, keeping the
26	 * audit trail decoupled from the application's diagnostic logging. Each successful owner
27	 * creation produces a single line carrying the identifying facts of the new record.
28	 */
29	@Component
30	public class OwnerAuditLogger {
31	
32	    private static final Logger AUDIT = LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT");
33	
34	    /**
35	     * Emits an audit line for a newly created owner, recording its id, customer code,
36	     * registration date and membership level.
37	     *
38	     * @param owner the persisted owner (must already have an assigned id)
39	     */
40	    public void logCreated(Owner owner) {
41	        AUDIT.info("Owner created: id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={}",
42	            owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate(), owner.getMembershipLevel());
43	    }
44	}

content.text:
Here is the complete, ordered sequence of what happens when an owner is created via `POST /api/owners`, handled by `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` (`src/main/java/.../rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java:143-171`).

## Before the method body

0. **Authorization** — `@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")` requires the `OWNER_ADMIN` role. (Bean Validation on `OwnerFieldsDto` — e.g. `@Size`, the 4-digit postcode pattern — is also applied by Spring on binding, before the handler runs.)

## In `addOwner`, in order

1. **Normalize address** (side-effect, on the DTO) — `AddressNormalizer.normalize(...)`: trims, collapses internal whitespace, upper-cases, and expands whole-word street abbreviations (`ST→STREET`, `RD→ROAD`, `AVE→AVENUE`). `null` stays `null`.

2. **Validate required fields** — `OwnerFieldsValidator.validateRequiredFields(...)`: rejects if any of `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, `telephone` is null or blank → `MissingOwnerFieldsException`. (Runs on the already-normalized address.)

3. **Map DTO → `Owner`** entity (`ownerMapper.toOwner`).

4. **Normalize + validate telephone** (side-effect) — `TelephoneNormalizer.normalize(...)`: strips formatting, produces canonical E.164 (`+` then 8–15 digits), defaulting to `+61` and dropping a leading `0` when no country code is given. Rejects a wrong total length, or a national-number length that doesn't match a recognized country → `InvalidTelephoneException`.

5. **Normalize + validate email** (side-effect) — `EmailNormalizer.normalize(...)`: lower-cases; if present it must match the email regex → `InvalidEmailException`. `null` (email is optional) stays `null`.

6. **Validate postcode** — `PostcodeValidator.validate(city, postcode)`: if a postcode is present, it must fall in the range for the city's region → `InvalidPostcodeException`. `null` postcode is accepted; unknown region accepts any 4-digit value.

7. **Set registration date** (side-effect) — defaults to `LocalDate.now()` if none was supplied, then rolls it forward to a business day via `BusinessDayAdjuster.toBusinessDay(...)` (Sat/Sun → next Monday).

8. **Daily capacity check** — `dailyRegistrationCapacityValidator.validateHasCapacity(registrationDate)`: rejects if ≥ 100 owners already registered on that (business) day → `DailyRegistrationLimitExceededException`.

9. **Household assignment** (conditional side-effect) — only if `sharesHousehold` is `TRUE`: `householdRegistrar.assignHousehold(owner)`. If an existing household (same last name + address) is found, it shares/derives one `householdId` and **saves the existing members** that lacked it, then sets the new owner's `householdId`. If no such household exists, nothing is assigned.

10. **Identity uniqueness check** — `identityUniquenessValidator.validateUnique(owner)`: rejects if any existing owner has the same identity key (`normalizedTelephone + '|' + email + '|' + householdId`) → `DuplicateOwnerIdentityException`. (Runs after telephone/email/household are in final form.)

11. **City capacity check** — `cityOwnerCapacityValidator.validateHasCapacity(city)`: rejects if the city (case-insensitive) already holds ≥ 50 owners → `CityOwnerCapacityExceededException`.

12. **Set namesake count** (side-effect) — `namesakeCounter.count(firstName, lastName)`: number of existing owners with the same first+last name (case-insensitive), stored on the owner.

13. **Generate customer code** (side-effect) — `CustomerCodeGenerator.generate(city, lastName, cityOwnerCounter.count(city))`: `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`, where NNNN = (current case-insensitive city owner count) + 1, zero-padded.

14. **Persist the owner** — `clinicService.saveOwner(owner)` (assigns the id).

15. **Generate membership number** (side-effect, post-save) — `MembershipNumberGenerator.generate(customerCode, registrationDate)`: `<customerCode>-M<YY>` using the last two digits of the registration year.

16. **Audit log** (side-effect) — `ownerAuditLogger.logCreated(owner)`: writes one line to the `AUDIT` logger with id, customer code, registration date, and membership level.

17. **Build response** — map to `OwnerDto`, set the `Location` header to `/api/owners/{id}`, and return `201 CREATED`.

A couple of things worth noting: the method is **not `@Transactional`**, so the existing-member saves in step 9 and the new-owner save in step 14 are separate commits — a rejection in steps 10/11 after a household backfill in step 9 leaves those backfill saves persisted. Also `membershipNumber` (step 15) is set only on the in-memory entity *after* the save, so it's returned in the response but is not itself persisted by this handler.
